mapper.select: select id, title, content, category, author, user_id, create_time, update_time from knowledge
select id, title, content, category, author, user_id, create_time, update_time from knowledge where user_id = #{userId}
select id, title, content, category, user_id, author, create_time, update_time from knowledge where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into knowledge( title, content, category, author, user_id, create_time, update_time ) values( #{title}, #{content}, #{category}, #{author}, #{userId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update knowledge set title=#{title}, content =#{content}, category = #{category}, author= #{author}, update_time= #{updateTime} where id=#{id}
